tools.name: github_list_repos
tools.description: List repositories the token can access (optionally for an org).

org.description: Organisation login; omit for the authenticated user

tools.name: github_get_repo
tools.description: Get repository metadata (default branch, visibility, open issues, permissions).

tools.name: github_list_issues
tools.description: List issues (not PRs) in a repository with optional state/labels/assignee filters.

tools.name: github_get_issue
tools.description: Get a single issue with body, labels, assignees and comment count.

tools.name: github_list_issue_comments
tools.description: List comments on an issue or pull request.

tools.name: github_search_issues
tools.description: Search issues and PRs with GitHub search syntax, e.g. "repo:acme/api is:open label:bug".

tools.name: github_list_pulls
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository.

tools.name: github_get_pull
tools.description: Get a pull request: title, body, head/base, mergeable state, review decision.

tools.name: github_get_pull_diff
tools.description: Get the unified diff of a pull request (truncated at 120 KB).

tools.name: github_list_pull_files
tools.description: List files changed in a pull request with additions/deletions and patch.

tools.name: github_list_pull_reviews
tools.description: List reviews on a pull request.

tools.name: github_get_file
tools.description: Read a file from the repository at a ref (decoded text, max 200 KB).

ref.description: Branch, tag or SHA; default branch when omitted

tools.name: github_list_directory
tools.description: List the entries of a directory in the repository.

tools.name: github_search_code
tools.description: Search code with GitHub code search syntax, e.g. "repo:acme/api validateToken language:php".

tools.name: github_list_commits
tools.description: List recent commits on a branch or path.

tools.name: github_list_branches
tools.description: List branches with their protection flag.

tools.name: github_list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs (CI results) with status and conclusion.

tools.name: github_get_workflow_run
tools.description: Get one workflow run and its jobs/steps with conclusions.

tools.name: github_list_check_runs
tools.description: List check runs for a commit SHA or branch (status checks on a PR head).

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue.

tools.name: github_update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue: title, body, state, labels or assignees.

tools.name: github_add_comment
tools.description: Comment on an issue or pull request.

tools.name: github_create_branch
tools.description: Create a branch from another branch (or SHA).

from.description: Source branch or SHA; default branch when omitted

tools.name: github_commit_file
tools.description: Create or update one file on a branch with a commit message (content as plain text).

tools.name: github_create_pull
tools.description: Open a pull request from head into base.

tools.name: github_update_pull
tools.description: Update a pull request title/body/state/base or mark ready for review.

tools.name: github_request_reviewers
tools.description: Request reviewers on a pull request.

tools.name: github_submit_review
tools.description: Submit a pull request review (COMMENT, APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES).

tools.name: github_trigger_workflow
tools.description: Dispatch a GitHub Actions workflow (workflow_dispatch) on a ref with inputs.

tools.name: github_rerun_workflow
tools.description: Re-run a workflow run (optionally failed jobs only).

tools.name: github_merge_pull
tools.description: Merge a pull request (merge, squash or rebase).

tools.name: github_delete_branch
tools.description: Delete a branch.

tools.name: jira_list_projects
tools.description: List Jira projects visible to the connection.

tools.name: jira_search_issues
tools.description: Search issues with JQL, e.g. "project = ENG AND status = \"In Progress\" ORDER BY updated DESC".

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Get an issue with description, status, assignee, labels, components and links.

tools.name: jira_list_comments
tools.description: List comments on an issue.

tools.name: jira_list_transitions
tools.description: List the workflow transitions currently available for an issue.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_types
tools.description: List the issue types of a project (needed before creating an issue).

tools.name: jira_list_sprints
tools.description: List sprints on a board (Jira Software).

tools.name: jira_list_boards
tools.description: List Jira Software boards, optionally for a project.

tools.name: jira_search_users
tools.description: Find users by name or email (for assignment).

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue in a project.

tools.name: jira_update_issue
tools.description: Update summary, description, labels, priority or raw fields of an issue.

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue.

tools.name: jira_transition_issue
tools.description: Move an issue through its workflow by transition name or id (e.g. "In Progress", "Done").

tools.name: jira_assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to a user by account id (or null to unassign).

tools.name: jira_link_issues
tools.description: Link two issues (Blocks, Relates, Duplicate, …).

tools.name: jira_add_worklog
tools.description: Log time on an issue (e.g. "2h 30m").

tools.name: jira_delete_issue
tools.description: Delete an issue permanently.

tools.name: tests_run
tools.description: Start a test run on the configured runner (GitHub Actions workflow or HTTP CI endpoint). Returns a run id to poll with tests_get_run.

name.description: Label for this run, e.g. "PR #42 unit tests"

ref.description: Branch / SHA to test; runner default when omitted

tools.name: tests_get_run
tools.description: Get the current status and summary of a test run (refreshes from the runner).

tools.name: tests_list_runs
tools.description: List recent test runs for this server.

tools.name: tests_get_logs
tools.description: Get job/step results and captured logs for a test run.

tools.name: tests_cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a running test run.

tools.name: gmcp_whoami
tools.description: Describe this agent identity: server, key scope, policy, connected systems and limits.

tools.name: gmcp_list_permissions
tools.description: Dry-run the guardrails for every available tool (or one tool with sample args) and report allow / deny / approve.

args.description: Sample arguments to evaluate conditions against

tools.name: gmcp_recent_activity
tools.description: Your own recent tool calls from the audit log (status, reason, duration).

tools.name: gmcp_approval_status
tools.description: Check a pending approval. When approved, the tool result is returned here.

slack.label: Slack
slack.desc: Post run summaries and approval requests

shell.label: Local test runner
shell.desc: Run a command on a self-hosted runner

github.label: GitHub
github.desc: Issues, pull requests, files, branches, Actions runs.
github.help: Create a fine-grained personal access token with Contents, Issues, Pull requests, Actions (read/write as needed) and Metadata (read).

config.label: Default owner / org
config.hint: Used when an agent passes a bare repo name

jira.label: Jira
jira.desc: Projects, JQL search, issues, comments, transitions, sprints.
jira.help: Use a Jira Cloud API token (id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens) together with the account email.

tests.label: Test runner
tests.desc: Trigger and poll test runs on GitHub Actions or any HTTP CI endpoint.
tests.help: GitHub Actions: the workflow must have a workflow_dispatch trigger. HTTP: POST run_url receives {run_id,name,ref,suite,inputs} and should answer {id,status,url}; GET status_url (with {id}) answers {status,total,passed,failed,url,logs}.
